mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_user (account, password, nickname, avatar, email, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{account}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{email}, NOW(), NOW());
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_user SET account = #{account}, password = #{password}, nickname = #{nickname}, avatar = #{avatar}, email = #{email}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id};
